options.how: No weapons at all: you hide in darkness, break line of sight and flee, while staying in the dark or watching monsters drains sanity.
Guns and knives with scarce ammo and healing; Mr. X stalks the police station and can only be slowed, so you pick which fights to take.

sources.note: Amnesia: The Dark Descent: hunted, you must explore and escape
Resident Evil 2 (2019): survival horror with combat and resource management

options.how: Jennifer cannot fight: she searches the manor for items and secret routes that let her evade Scissorman, an unstoppable killer.
Guns and melee are available, but limited resources mean stealth and avoidance stretch every bullet you carry.

sources.note: Clock Tower: find ways to evade Scissorman, an unstoppable shears-wielding killer
The Evil Within: with limited resources at your disposal, you fight for survival

options.how: You are no fighter: the only answers to the asylum's inmates are running away and hiding until they pass.
Classic survival horror gunplay, but scarce ammo and healing make every fight a resource decision you may choose to dodge.

sources.note: Outlast: you are no fighter, your only chance is to run or hide
Signalis: carefully manage scarce resources

options.how: No weapons, gadgets or tools to fight back: each mechanised monster becomes a game of hide and seek as you slip past unseen.
A revolver starts with one bullet and supplies must be scavenged and crafted, so each shot is weighed against the noise it makes.

sources.note: SOMA: no weapons, you cannot fight back, all you can do is run and hide
Amnesia: The Bunker: one bullet in the revolver and scarce supplies to scavenge and craft

options.how: Tasi has no weapons: she avoids darkness, crouches and hides from monsters while managing her own fear.
Underpowered and underprepared: scavenge and craft items to evade, distract or face enemies head on, never with enough to feel safe.

sources.note: Amnesia: Rebirth: avoid darkness, hide from monsters and solve puzzles
Alien: Isolation: scavenge resources and craft items to evade, distract or face enemies

options.how: Six never fights the distorted adults: you sneak past them, throw objects to send them elsewhere, and escape.
Find and craft weapons from scavenged resources, then barricade your hideout and fight through each night.

sources.note: Little Nightmares: heavy stealth element, evading the creatures and sneaking past
Darkwood: scavenge vital resources, build defenses, find and craft weapons

options.how: You are defenseless: no weapon helps against the entities, so you stay in the light to keep your sanity and avoid them.
You can shoot back, but scarce ammo and supplies turn every encounter into a choice between fighting, sneaking or running.

sources.note: Visage: you are defenseless, no weapons; stay in the light to avoid going insane
The Evil Within: limited resources, fight for survival

options.how: With no way to attack, encounters are solved by breaking line of sight, running and hiding until the pursuer gives up.
Melee and firearms exist, but materials are scarce, so defending at night competes with scavenging and crafting by day.

sources.note: Outlast: you are no fighter, run or hide
Darkwood: scavenge by day, defend by night, weapons to find and craft

options.how: One Alien hunts by its senses while a director AI keeps it near you using a menace gauge, so encounters are never staged.
Animatronics follow patterns you learn; you watch security cameras and ration limited power for doors and lights.

sources.note: Alien: Isolation: director AI manages a menace gauge to steer the Alien
Five Nights at Freddy's: watch security cameras, very limited electricity per night

options.how: Authored scares: the house reshapes itself when you look away, a guided walk through hand-built transformations.
The Neighbor's AI learns from your routes, adding bear traps and cameras where you keep entering and cutting off escapes.

sources.note: Layers of Fear: the environment reshapes itself when you look away
Hello Neighbor: advanced AI that learns from your every move

options.how: A cinematic slasher whose scares are staged set pieces; your decisions decide who survives, not how a monster behaves.
The AI Director tailors the frequency and ferocity of infected attacks to your team's performance, so runs never repeat.

sources.note: Until Dawn: slasher horror where every decision can mean life or death
Left 4 Dead: the AI Director tailors frequency and ferocity of attacks to performance

options.how: A looping corridor of hand-made anomalies: spot one and turn back, see none and keep walking. Every scare is authored.
Escaped entities roam the facility; SCP-173 moves only while unwatched, and a blink meter forces you to look away.

sources.note: The Exit 8: observe anomalies in an endless passageway and turn back if you find one
SCP: Containment Breach: SCP-173 is frozen while looked at, plus a blinking mechanic

options.how: A linear first-person story of a doomed freighter crew; dread is authored scene by scene instead of coming from a hunting monster.
An ever-present hunter reacts to your every move and sound, with randomized behavior and item placement so no run repeats.

sources.note: Mouthwashing: first-person narrative horror following a dying freighter crew
Amnesia: The Bunker: ever-present threat reacting to every move and sound, randomization

options.how: Threats arrive by learnable patterns you read on cameras; survival is rationing power, not evading a free-roaming hunter.
Granny hears everything: dropped items and creaking floors send her running to the sound, so your own noise drives the hunt.

sources.note: Five Nights at Freddy's: watch the cameras, limited power for doors and lights
Granny: she hears everything and runs to the sound

options.how: Scares are staged with movie-like cinematography; you shape outcomes through choices, not by outwitting an enemy AI.
Granny roams the house and comes to any noise; you hide in wardrobes and coffins, but she may see where you hide.

sources.note: Until Dawn: movie-like cinematography, choices decide who survives
Granny: hide in wardrobes and coffins, but she may see you hiding

options.how: Rooms warp to mirror the painter's crumbling sanity; fear comes from authored transformations along a set path.
Entities roam a large site independently of your route; you track them yourself and must keep eyes on SCP-173 to stay alive.

sources.note: Layers of Fear: the world warps to reflect the painter's crumbling sanity
SCP: Containment Breach: escaped entities roaming; SCP-173 frozen while watched
